name: The Scythe of Elune
summary: In Darkshire, the trail of the Scythe of Elune leads into the worgen hunt. Jonathan Carevin sends you to Roland's Doom, where the beasts were first seen, linking an ancient night elf relic in Kalimdor to the worgen now troubling Duskwood.

sections.title: A Hunt in the Dark
sections.body: After tracing Priestess Velinde Starsong across Kalimdor and speaking with the Carevin household in Darkshire, you find common cause with Jonathan Carevin. Nightbane worgen have overrun southern Duskwood, driving miners out and threatening what remains of the township. Carevin does not fully understand the beasts' supernatural origin, but he recognizes the value of someone willing to hunt them. He points you toward Roland's Doom, the mine where the fiends were first sighted.

sections.title: Ghosts of Roland's Doom
sections.body: Deep in Roland's Doom, among packs of vicious Nightbane, an undisturbed mound of earth lies beneath the tunnels. Disturbing the soil reveals the lingering specter of Velinde Starsong. The night elf priestess came into this cave carrying the Scythe of Elune, but met her end beneath Duskwood. Velinde laments that the worgen she unleashed now run rampant, and that the Scythe granted by her goddess is lost.

faq.q: Where do I look for signs of the Scythe?
faq.answer: Search Roland's Doom, the abandoned mine in southeastern Duskwood. Fight through the Nightbane worgen to an undisturbed mound of earth in the tunnels.
Jonathan Carevin belongs to the Carevin family in Darkshire. With few defenders left against evil, he trades information with outsiders seeking to cull the worgen numbers.

faq.q: What happened to Velinde Starsong in the mine?
faq.answer: An undisturbed mound of earth deep in Roland's Doom holds the answer to Velinde Starsong's fate and the Scythe's whereabouts. Examine it to learn what to carry back to Jonathan Carevin.

faq.q: What is the Scythe of Elune?
faq.answer: The Scythe of Elune is a sacred night elf artifact received by Priestess Velinde Starsong. The Sentinels believe the goddess Elune granted it to her as a boon.

faq.q: Why did the worgen appear in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Jonathan Carevin says the worgen appeared out of nowhere, and they were first found in Roland's Doom to the south. Signs of the Scythe of Elune in the mine reveal why they appeared.
Calor is an associate of the Carevin family in Darkshire. After your discoveries in Roland's Doom, Jonathan instructs him to focus entirely on containing the worgen threat.

angles.text: Finding Priestess Velinde Starsong's final resting place reveals the terrible price paid when the Scythe of Elune passed beyond the Sisterhood's supervision.
Unraveling the Nightbane worgen mystery gives Darkshire and the Alliance their first real answers about the horrors stalking southern Duskwood.
The wild worgen loosed by the Scythe of Elune warn druids of the cost of forces beyond control.
